title: Retry-After gauge stays without a source label (shared Slack bucket)
answers: Should the Slack Retry-After gauge have a source label?
How to get per-flow 429 attribution for Slack?
body:
The Slack `Retry-After` gauge keeps per-bucket labels only, with no `source`. Slack applies one rate limit per workspace, app and method, so all flows calling a method wait on the same reset. A `source` label would split one bucket into one series per flow, showing the same reset repeatedly (rejected in review of this change).
- Per-flow 429 attribution comes from `slack_api_requests_total{status_code="429", source=...}` instead.
- Client construction is in posthog/models/integration/slack.py:SlackIntegration.
applies: Slack egress metrics work in posthog/egress/slack and SlackIntegration.
